# CentarStory

CentarStory is a cultural guide to the Municipality of Centar in Skopje. It covers monuments, memorials, museums, walks, food, and how to move through the city centre.

The atlas is written in English, Macedonian, Serbian, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Albanian. English lives at the root. The other languages use a prefix: /mk, /sr, /tr, /uk, /sq.

## What a page is

- /around — the atlas and a walk built from a year
- /places/{slug} — one monument or place, with the story and the map pin
- /museums/{slug} — one museum
- /routes/{slug} — a themed walk
- /scan — photograph a monument or museum and open its story when the picture matches
- /food, /food/places/{slug}, /food/dishes/{slug} — kitchens and dishes
- /events — municipal cultural dates
- /transport — how to arrive and move
- /legal, /privacy, /terms, /cookies, /impressum — the legal pages

Photographs are credited and licensed. A page without a photograph says so. Do not treat a portrait or a news picture as the monument.

## Machine-readable

- /sitemap.xml lists every public page in all six languages
- Place and museum pages include schema.org TouristAttraction or Museum markup
